verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer for AI agents. A developer platform like this could plausibly offer scheduled jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows background reasoning (the deriver and the opt-in Dreamer), which are internal processing behaviors rather than user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. No scheduling, cron, or recurring-workflow feature is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
